node.title: L1 official split-pencil value capacity
node.statement: Fix a normalized perturbation P(Z)=Z^p+Q(Z), deg Q<p, on an official n-point multiplicative coset. Distinct fully split degree-p fibers are disjoint, giving at most floor(n/p)<=23 split values. The gcd G_Q(T) of the coefficient remainders of (Z^n-alpha) mod (P-T) is exactly their squarefree value polynomial and has degree at most 23; pair existence forces a narrow-matrix rank defect. If 2p>n no pair exists. In the m=2 band, a complement locator C uniquely determines the pair through (Z^n-alpha)/C=R^2+c. Polynomial Mason-Stothers, retaining its Frobenius-degenerate branch, proves that such a pair forces n=2p+2. Every pair is then indexed by an antipodal complement C=Z^2-b, with R=Z*C^((p-1)/2), c=b^p, and locators R+-delta. There are exactly n/2 unordered pairs, occurring only at depths p and p+1. Hence all broader m=2 minimum-width strata are empty. The result does not control m>=3 perturbations, higher widths, or the full L1 fiber.
